keywords.title: Keywords (one or more)
keywords.description: Full-text search across the process name/description/entity (SoQL $q). Add several terms to search them one by one: each term is queried separately, every record is tagged with the term that matched it, and the run reports a result count per term. Leave empty to browse by the filters below instead, or to pull the most recently published processes.

entidad.title: Entity name contains
entidad.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the contracting entity's name (e.g. "alcaldia", "ministerio de salud").

departamento.title: Department
departamento.description: Exact department name as SECOP records it (e.g. "Antioquia", "Distrito Capital de Bogotá").

estadoResumen.title: Process status
estadoResumen.description: Exact status as SECOP records it. Pick from the live values found in the dataset (counts as of 2026-09-10).

fechaDesde.title: Published from
fechaDesde.description: Only processes published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters on "fecha_de_publicacion_del".

fechaHasta.title: Published until
fechaHasta.description: Only processes published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxItems.title: Max records
maxItems.description: Stop after this many records. The dataset has ~9 million rows, so an unfiltered pull with a huge value will take a long time and produce a huge dataset - filter first.

whereClause.title: Advanced: raw SoQL $where
whereClause.description: For power users: a raw Socrata SoQL $where clause, combined with the filters above using AND. See the dataset's column list at datos.gov.co for field names. Leave empty unless you need something the filters above don't cover.
whereClause.sectionDescription: Only touch these if the filters above aren't enough.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Records per API request. Larger pages mean fewer requests but bigger responses held in memory at once.

appToken.title: Socrata app token (optional)
appToken.description: Free token from a datos.gov.co account (Sign in -> Edit Profile -> Developer Settings -> Create New App Token). Not required, but raises your rate limit if you run this often. Not a login/cookie - just an API usage token.
